blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY—The Confederation of Sugar Producers Associations Inc. (Confed) unanimously re-elected Aurelio Gerardo Valderrama Jr. as president for Crop Years 2026-2027 and 2027-2028 during its annual membership meeting in Makati City on Wednesday, Sept. 16. The re-election marks Valderrama’s fifth and sixth crop years as Confed president, making him the longest-serving president in the federation’s history, according to a press release from the group. Joining Valderrama in the newly elected executive lineup are Loreto Mabborang, vice president for Luzon; Alfonso Gamboa, vice president for Visayas; Antonio Ferdinand Marañon, vice president for Mindanao; Nicholas Gerardo Ledesma Jr., treasurer; and Maria Regina Martin, […]...
